windowclass.name: wfrp1e_standard_test_selector
windowclass.script:
local nodeCharacter = nil local sSelectedSkillRulesId = ""
local function signedModifier(nModifier) nModifier = tonumber(nModifier) or 0
if nModifier >= 0 then return "+" .. tostring(nModifier) end
return tostring(nModifier) end
local function handleTestSelected(sTestId) if not nodeCharacter then return end
local tResult = StandardTestManagerWFRP1E.performSelectedSkillTest( nodeCharacter, sSelectedSkillRulesId, sTestId )
if tResult and tResult.launched == true then close() end end
function setContext( nodeChar, sRulesId, aCandidateTestIds ) nodeCharacter = nodeChar sSelectedSkillRulesId = tostring(sRulesId or "")
choices.closeAll()
local nCreated = 0
for _, sTestId in ipairs(aCandidateTestIds or {}) do local tTarget = StandardTestManagerWFRP1E.resolveSelectedSkillTarget( nodeCharacter, sSelectedSkillRulesId, sTestId )
if tTarget.valid then local w = choices.createWindowWithClass( "wfrp1e_standard_test_choice", nil )
if w then w.configure( sTestId, tTarget.baseTarget, tTarget.skillModifier, tTarget.target, handleTestSelected )
nCreated = nCreated + 1 end end end
return nCreated end

static.text: Choose the named test for this Skill.

windowclass.name: wfrp1e_standard_test_choice
windowclass.script:
local sTestId = "" local fSelect = nil
function configure( sId, nBaseTarget, nSkillModifier, nFinalTarget, fCallback ) sTestId = tostring(sId or "") fSelect = fCallback
local nModifier = tonumber(nSkillModifier) or 0 local sModifier = tostring(nModifier)
if nModifier >= 0 then sModifier = "+" .. sModifier end
local sText = sTestId .. " | " .. tostring(nFinalTarget) .. "% (base " .. tostring(nBaseTarget) .. "% + Skill " .. sModifier .. "%)"
select_test.setText( sText, sText, sText ) end
function handleSelect() if fSelect then fSelect(sTestId) end end
